description: This file is a Python script that defines a test suite for generating image files using GIMP's Python API, specifically for testing Kivy's ImageLoader. It includes configuration for various image types, patterns, and export formats, and contains functions to create, draw, and save test images with different properties.

methods.name: v0_pattern_pixel
methods.description: Returns pixel data for a given pattern character in specified format.

methods.name: v0_filename
methods.description: Generates filename based on image parameters.

methods.name: save_image
methods.description: Saves an image to a file in various formats.

methods.name: draw_pattern
methods.description: Draws a pattern on a GIMP layer.

methods.name: make_images
methods.description: Creates images with specified pattern, alpha, and format, then saves them.

methods.name: makepatterns
methods.description: Generates a list of pattern strings based on allowed characters.

methods.name: plugin_main
methods.description: Main function to generate a test suite of images based on user options.
